sam: Created RC rc-2026-03-20-01 for the runtime KV-warm fix. Asking for quick ops + QA signoff before we promote to prod. Release notes: https://go.redwood/release/rc-2026-03-20-01

maria: Quick skim of the notes — no DB migrations or schema changes, right?

sam: Correct, no schema. Perf tweak to attention kernel selection and a KV prewarm stage. Important: KV warm must run before shifting traffic. Recommend 10% canary for 30m.

jin: OK, I'll run the smoke scripts and sanity evals after QA finishes. Can we add a qa-hold in the promote command?

deploy-bot: /promote rc-2026-03-20-01 --pin --canary=10% --qa-hold

owen: I'll act as sheriff for the window and own the rollback decision if metrics break. What are our hard thresholds?

eva: Proposing rollback triggers: error-rate > 0.5% sustained for 3 min, p95 latency > 300ms over baseline, or a token-cost delta > +30% for 5m. Also any functional regression from QA failures.

maria: QA here. Starting regression run now (ETA ~20m). Leaving a note if any test fails.

jin: smoke scripts queued. I'll watch logs and KV warm logs. :eyes:

sam: For rollback playbook — pin previous artifact and run promote back to the last green:
```
/promote rc-2026-03-19-09 --pin --traffic=100%
```
Also ensure autoscaler remains enabled during rollback to avoid cold-start spikes.

owen: I'll set two short-lived alerts: latency-spike and cost-anomaly. If either fires, I'll call rollback after 2 failed checks.

deploy-bot: Promotion scheduled for 2026-03-20T22:00Z UTC. Preflight KV-warm will start at 21:50Z. Please react :thumbsup: to indicate go.

maria: :thumbsup:

jin: :thumbsup:

owen: :thumbsup:

sam: Thanks team — I'll kick off the KV warm 10m before and post status here. If anyone spots anything odd in the preflight, flag it immediately.

maria: noted, will post QA summary when complete.

jin: watching logs.

deploy-bot: Deploybot note: canary will ramp 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 10m hold per step unless manual pause.

sam: Copy. Will be on standby for rollback. :rocket:
